column4: People of the State of California — DDA Priya Mahalingam, Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office, Norwalk Branch
column5: Two-count felony complaint filed against Raymond T. Keeler. Count 1 — Veh. Code § 23153(a) (driving under the influence causing bodily injury, felony). Count 2 — Veh. Code § 23153(b) (driving with BAC 0.08% or more causing bodily injury, felony). Enhancement allegations: (A) Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) great bodily injury as to Yolanda Reyes; (B) Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) great bodily injury as to Devin Cho; (C) Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) great bodily injury as to Alicia Mowbray; (D) Veh. Code § 23558 multiple victims. Verified declaration executed by DDA Mahalingam at Norwalk, California, on 11/14/2025. Supporting documentary references: RPD Report No. TC-2025-1018; LASD-SSB Certificate of Analysis No. 25-0442117 dated 11/07/2025 (whole-blood ethanol 0.14% w/v, Criminalist Alan Whitford); chain-of-custody Form COC-25-0442117
column6: Filed; arraignment set for 11/21/2025 in Dept. N-C

column5: Defendant personally present, out of custody on bail/O.R. Counsel appointed for defendant: Adrian E. Bellamy, Deputy Public Defender, Los Angeles County Public Defender's Office. Court advised defendant of the nature of the charges in Case No. NA123456-01, of the maximum possible penalties, and of constitutional rights (Boykin/Tahl). Defendant acknowledged receipt of complaint. Defendant entered a plea of NOT GUILTY to Counts 1 and 2 and DENIED all § 12022.7(a) and § 23558 enhancement allegations. People submitted initial discovery. Protective order (Pen. Code § 136.2) declined by the People; standard stay-away and no-contact conditions declined. Release status continued on prior O.R. conditions
column6: Not guilty plea entered; preliminary hearing set within statutory time

column5: Trial-court readiness / discovery status conference. People confirmed production of initial discovery: RPD Traffic Collision Report No. TC-2025-1018; audio-video from RPD field response; chain-of-custody documentation; LASD-SSB Certificate of Analysis dated 11/07/2025; DMV records return; and preliminary witness list. Defense reserved right to file § 1538.5 suppression and § 1054 motions

Preliminary hearing held before Hon. Marion T. Escamilla. Witnesses called by the People: Officer Ramona Delacruz, RPD #2814 (percipient — collision investigation, field sobriety, arrest); Criminalist Alan Whitford, LASD-SSB (analyst — evidentiary blood BAC). Exhibits admitted: People's 1 — RPD Report No. TC-2025-1018; People's 2 — LASD-SSB Certificate of Analysis No. 25-0442117 (0.14% w/v); People's 3 — Chain-of-Custody Form COC-25-0442117; People's 4 — booking record. Defense presented no witnesses; cross-examination only. Court found sufficient cause to believe defendant committed the offenses charged and the enhancements alleged
column6: Defendant HELD TO ANSWER on Counts 1 and 2 and on all enhancement allegations

column3: Information Filed and Arraignment on Information
column5: Information filed by the People restating the two felony counts and enhancement allegations consistent with the 12/12/2025 holding order. Defendant personally present with Deputy Public Defender Bellamy. Arraigned on the Information; acknowledged receipt; entered a plea of NOT GUILTY to Counts 1 and 2 and DENIED all enhancements. Matter set for pretrial conference. Time not waived at this stage
column6: Not guilty plea to Information; pretrial conference set 01/23/2026

column5: Trial readiness / pretrial conference. Parties reported ongoing plea discussions. Defense reported review of blood-specimen chain of custody complete and no § 1538.5 motion contemplated. Defense inquiry as to eligibility for the first-offender DUI-causing-injury program under Veh. Code § 23556(b)(3); People represented no objection contingent on plea to Count 1. No motions filed

On joint motion of the People and defense, matter continued for further plea negotiations, completion of victim-impact information from Rivergate Regional Trauma Center and Alder Creek Neuro-Rehabilitation Institute, and coordination with the Los Angeles County Probation Department regarding disposition terms. Defendant personally waived statutory speedy-trial time on the record (Pen. Code §§ 1049.5, 1050); court made findings of good cause; no showing of prejudice to defendant
column6: Continued to 03/13/2026 on stipulation; time waived by defendant

column5: Parties reported tentative negotiated disposition: defendant to enter plea of no contest to Count 1 (Veh. Code § 23153(a)); remaining count and enhancement allegations to be dismissed on People's motion with Harvey waiver; formal probation grant with county-jail condition; DUI-causing-injury program; license revocation; victim restitution reserved. Defense to prepare and execute Felony Advisement of Rights, Waiver, and Plea Form (LASC CRIM 100) and Conditions of Formal Probation form (LASC PROB-A)
column6: Change-of-plea and sentencing calendared for 04/02/2026 at 8:30 a.m., Dept. N-C

column5: Change-of-plea hearing before Hon. Marion T. Escamilla, Dept. N-C. Appearances: for the People, DDA Priya Mahalingam; for defendant, Deputy Public Defender Adrian E. Bellamy. Defendant personally present, out of custody. Court advised defendant on the record of the nature of the charges, maximum possible sentence, direct and collateral consequences (including Pen. Code § 1016.5 immigration advisement, mandatory license revocation, loss of firearm rights, and DNA sample requirement under Pen. Code § 296). Defendant personally waived constitutional rights (jury trial, confrontation, against self-incrimination, compulsory process). Defense counsel joined waivers and stipulated to factual basis based upon police reports, LASD-SSB Certificate of Analysis dated 11/07/2025, and preliminary hearing transcript on file. Defendant withdrew previously entered plea of not guilty and entered a plea of NO CONTEST as to Count 1 (Veh. Code § 23153(a), felony). Court found the plea knowing, intelligent, and voluntary; factual basis established; plea accepted
column6: No contest plea to Count 1 accepted; defendant adjudged GUILTY of Veh. Code § 23153(a) (felony); Harvey waiver executed for restitution purposes

column3: Dismissal of Remaining Counts and Enhancements
column4: Court — on motion of the People
column5: On motion of the People pursuant to the negotiated disposition and in the interests of justice under Pen. Code § 1385: Count 2 (Veh. Code § 23153(b)) DISMISSED; enhancement allegation A under Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) (Yolanda Reyes) DISMISSED; enhancement allegation B under Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) (Devin Cho) DISMISSED; enhancement allegation C under Pen. Code § 12022.7(a) (Alicia Mowbray) DISMISSED; enhancement allegation D under Veh. Code § 23558 (multiple victims) DISMISSED
column6: Dismissed pursuant to Pen. Code § 1385; Harvey waiver retained

column5: Defendant waived referral to Probation, formal probation report, and statutory time for pronouncement of judgment (Pen. Code §§ 1191, 1203). Judgment pronounced on Count 1: imposition of sentence SUSPENDED; defendant placed on formal (supervised) probation for a term of THREE (3) YEARS on terms and conditions set forth in the Minute Order and executed Conditions of Formal Probation form (LASC PROB-A). County jail commitment of 270 days ordered as a condition of probation, with 2 days custody credit (1 actual + 1 Pen. Code § 4019 conduct). Enrollment in a licensed three-month first-offender DUI-causing-injury program under Veh. Code § 23556(b)(3), with proof of enrollment within 30 days and proof of completion prior to termination of probation. Driver's license REVOKED pursuant to Veh. Code §§ 13350 and 13352; Clerk directed to forward abstract to the Department of Motor Vehicles. Standard alcohol conditions imposed: no driving with any measurable alcohol (Veh. Code § 23600); chemical testing upon demand; no possession or consumption of alcoholic beverages; no entry into establishments where alcohol is the primary item of sale. Fourth-waiver search condition as to person, residence, vehicle, and property. No firearms (Pen. Code § 29800). No leaving California without prior written permission. DNA/fingerprints ordered (Pen. Code § 296). Financial obligations imposed: $300 restitution fine (Pen. Code § 1202.4(b)); $300 probation-revocation fine (Pen. Code § 1202.44, suspended unless probation revoked); $40 court operations assessment (Pen. Code § 1465.8); $30 conviction assessment (Gov. Code § 70373); statutory penalty assessments as required by law
column6: Judgment entered; Felony Abstract of Judgment (Judicial Council Form CR-290) filed 04/02/2026; defendant remanded to Sheriff for delivery to Los Angeles County Jail for service of the 270-day term as a condition of probation

column5: Pursuant to Pen. Code § 1202.4(f) and Cal.
